usage: deskops closeout [-h] {commit,supersede,verify} ...

positional arguments:
  {commit,supersede,verify}
    commit              Create the tool-made closing commit, linked to a run
                        evidence directory or marked manual.
    supersede           Close a task whose subject no longer exists, naming a
                        reason and a resolvable ref.
    verify              Strictly verify closeout evidence gates for one task
                        and print a structured report.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
